units.source_text: 二条院里的人见他如此深夜出游，都觉得奇怪，相与议论道：“真教人难当呢。

en.t: The people at the Nijo residence saw him going out so late at night and thought it strange, saying among themselves, "It is truly hard to bear.

units.source_text: 近来比往常越发不耐性了，常常偷偷地出门。

en.t: Lately he has been more restless than usual, and often slips out in secret.

units.source_text: 尤其是昨天，那神色真苦恼啊！

en.t: Especially yesterday, his expression looked so troubled!

units.source_text: 为什么要这样东钻西钻呢？”

en.t: Why must he go sneaking here and there like this?"
After saying this, they all sighed.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一回到家，实在吃不消，便躺下了，就此生起病来，非常痛苦。

en.t: As soon as Prince Genji returned home, he could bear it no longer and lay down; from then on he fell ill and suffered greatly.

units.source_text: 两三天之后，身体显得异常衰弱。

en.t: After two or three days, his body appeared unusually weak.

units.source_text: 皇上也闻知此事，非常担心，便在各处寺院里举行祛病祈祷：

en.t: The Emperor also heard of this and was deeply worried, so he had prayers for recovery performed at temples everywhere:

units.source_text: 凡阴阳道的平安忏、恶魔祓禊、密教的念咒祈祷，无不举行。

en.t: Every rite was carried out, from Onmyodo penitential prayers for peace, to exorcisms and purifications against evil spirits, to esoteric Buddhist incantations.

units.source_text: 天下人纷纷议论，都说：“源氏公子这盖世无双、过于妖艳的美男子，

en.t: People everywhere talked about it, all saying, "Prince Genji is an incomparable, almost too dazzlingly beautiful man,

units.source_text: 不会长生在这尘世间的。”

en.t: and he will not live long in this dusty world."
